name: filesystem read and write streams
source: import { createReadStream, createWriteStream, rmSync } from 'node:fs'; async function main(): Promise<void> { const path = '/tmp/thaw-node-fs-stream.txt'; rmSync(path, { force: true }); await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => { const output = createWriteStream(path, { highWaterMark: 2 }); output.on('error', reject); output.end('streamed', resolve); }); const chunks: string[] = []; await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => { const input = createReadStream(path, { highWaterMark: 3, encoding: 'utf8' }); input.on('data', (chunk: string): void => chunks.push(chunk)); input.on('end', resolve); input.on('error', reject); }); console.log(chunks.join(''), chunks.length); rmSync(path); }
